allocation_policy: Standalone cold 60-task replay scenario on same L4. Shared host setup/build/freeze, idle, final collection and cleanup are replayed once per treatment; model download/verification and its own research request batch are charged once. Explicit research probes/incremental archives are excluded. Common seconds = whole confirmed-absence allocation minus both model-specific phases minus recorded research-only intervals; all remaining gaps included. Two standalone scenarios are not additive components of the shared session. External preparation/network/other costs unknown, human labor excluded; actual treatment costs unknown. Cold lifecycle is a replay scenario using observed post-probe load/request timings, not a measured clean-cache cold-start benchmark.
scope: File localization only; scenario values are assumptions, not measured savings
